GitHub repo README Benchmark trends
Benchmark trends → Per-commit ns/op, B/op and allocs/op for every benchmark, with automatic regression alerts. Updated on each push to main. Test coverage → Line-by-line Go coverage report, regenerated on each push to main.

Read the trend, not the absolute numbers. Benchmarks run on shared GitHub-hosted runners, whose CPU and thermal behaviour vary between jobs. Use the charts to spot relative movement over time; a pull request is flagged only when a metric regresses past a deliberately loose threshold, and the alert is posted as a PR comment — it never blocks merges. For precise local A/B numbers, use benchstat as described in docs/BENCHMARKS.md.
